news.headline:
NRB Bearings reported Q2 revenue of INR 386 crores, up 18.8% YoY, with profit after tax reaching INR 36 crores.

Adjusted EBITDA stood at INR 71 crores with an 18.2% margin, backed by strong second-half growth visibility.

Source: ScoutQuest

news.headline:
Systematix Corporate Services approved the grant of 19,09,179 stock options under its ESOP 2025 scheme at Rs. 63.5.

Vested options can be exercised within a maximum period of four years from the vesting date.

Source: BSE

Systematix Corporate Services Q2 adjusted revenue rose 102% QoQ and 0.5% YoY to ₹56.1 crore.

Filed DRHPs exceeded ₹3,000 crore, with the active deal pipeline surpassing ₹12,600 crore across 27+ opportunities.

Source: ScoutQuest
